project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to manage exam and course-related functionality, likely for an educational platform. The application is structured around various Vue components representing different pages and data models. Router navigation drives the user experience, and components like ApplicationServices and ResultPage likely handle core business logic. The application’s organization suggests a modular design, but potential fragility exists due to direct routing from lower-level components.

layers.description: Responsible for user interface rendering and interaction.
Contains application's core logic and data manipulation.

macro_trends.title: Direct Routing from Low-Level Components
macro_trends.description: Multiple Vue components, including those representing user interfaces (e.g., ResultPage, ExamFormSubmission), are directly routed to via the Router. This creates a potential point of fragility and tightly couples UI with routing logic, making it difficult to change routing behavior without impacting UI components.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow starts with the user filling out an ExamFormSubmission.vue, potentially interacting with the ApplicationServices.vue and subsequently utilizing the ResultPage.vue to view their results. The dependency chain highlights a potential area for centralized fragility if significant changes are needed in this process.
